description: Discover unfamiliar fields. Omit index_ref for the root; each scope includes topic index_ref links, so follow the needed topic directly without first opening its scope. Follow returned references for nested records, dictionary values and variants. Collect the needed schema_ref values across topics, then read them together with get_planning_schema_definition. Reuse cached directories and definitions at the same schema name/version. Priorities are interview order, not requiredness. Do not explore unrelated topics or read schema before every save. Requires the authenticated One U Education account and declared planning scope; credentials and user identity are never tool arguments.

index_ref.description: Omit for the root directory. Copy a returned index_ref unchanged to navigate people, topics, records, dictionary values or variants; references belong to one schema name/version.

version.description: Only the current returned version is served.
